basis: Analyst-chosen sensitivity inputs, not empirical estimates, priors, benchmark outcomes or architecture-derived frequencies. No central scenario is preferred.
comparison: Same model, task distribution, independent acceptance, tools and maximum attempt/token budget. Baseline means direct Codex with normal engineering checks, not an unchecked self-report. Recovery must occur within the common budget; regression includes failures from overhead, interruptions or inappropriate guidance. External evaluator determines actual deliverability in both arms; Factory run status is not the shared outcome metric.
